inputs.text: Make it photorealistic. One continuous zoom from space: the whole Earth in orbit with real cloud systems, then straight down as satellite views of the land sharpen, through a layer of white clouds, then a fast forward swoop low over the ground to eye level at touchdown, where the land far below is touchdown's natural rock, soil and vegetation; the distant land fades naturally toward the horizon. The camera then pushes in slowly on one person standing at the viewpoint, who shifts their weight, glances out across the view to one side, then turns back toward the camera. Clear blue sky, bright sun from the side, crisp shadows, slight distant haze. Real satellite and aerial photography becoming handheld photography, natural colour, no text. No sun disc, no lens flare, no light rays or streaks.
